articles.title: DOJ says it will not reopen criminal probe into former Fed Chair Powell
articles.description: The confirmation comes after the Fed's inspector general report that said there were no grounds for a criminal referral over the mismanaged headquarters renovation.

articles.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
articles.description: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

articles.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
articles.description: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face—and whether the company can be held legally accountable.

articles.title: Anthropic to invest $100 million to train AI engineer talent
articles.description: Anthropic will invest $100 million to train nearly 10,000 AI engineers, partnering with a number of consulting firms.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: European crypto users have ‘more faith’ in regulated firms under MiCA: Bitpanda co-CEO
articles.description: Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction, Christian Trummer said MiCA has increased trust in regulated platforms and called for stricter enforcement against noncompliant firms.

articles.title: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are
articles.description: Ethereum's zkAPI lets users prepay in USDC and query AI models through cryptographic proofs, so no single party sees both who they are and what they ask.

articles.title: Oil prices lower as G7 nations to release diesel stocks, Saudis reportedly plan attack on Houthis
articles.description: The G7 will deploy 100 million barrels of reserves over the next four months, the group's leaders said in a joint statement.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield ticks higher despite weaker-than-expected jobs report
articles.description: U.S. Treasury yields rose despite a September jobs report came in much weaker than expected.

articles.title: Circle Pushes Back on MiCA's Bank-Deposit Mandate for Stablecoins
articles.description: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter—siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.

articles.title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
articles.description: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.

articles.title: FAA says Boeing 737 Max software glitch not a flight-safety issue
articles.description: The FAA on Monday said it was reviewing the software glitch, which could affect procedures during certain landings.

articles.title: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says
articles.description: Tavus says 26 of 54 people on a one-minute video call thought its new Griffin model was human. The results are the company's own, and the model isn't going to retail customers yet.

articles.title: How AI is redefining Wall Street jobs — and boosting demand for this new 'hottest skill' by 1,721%
articles.description: Banks are fueling a hiring surge for AI engineers who are good at "agent orchestration" — the ability to coordinate teams of specialized agents.

articles.title: $4.2B crypto bank Anchorage Digital cuts 17% of workforce: Report
articles.description: The reported cuts come as Anchorage expands its institutional footprint, including stablecoin issuance and a $100 million investment from Tether.

articles.title: David Ellison says combined Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery will be named Skydance
articles.description: It's a full-circle moment for a company that has undergone two major acquisitions within the last 18 months.

articles.title: Blast to wind down Ethereum L2 after costs outpace revenue
articles.description: Once among Ethereum’s largest layer-2 networks by total value locked, Blast is urging users to move their assets to mainnet ahead of the shutdown.

articles.title: Why Lilly and Novo are betting on amylin to power a new wave of obesity drugs after GLP-1s
articles.description: Eli Lilly and Novo are developing new amylin drugs that serve as another biological lever to pull in treating obesity and diabetes.

articles.title: Once a $2.3 Billion Network, Ethereum Layer-2 Blast Is Shutting Down
articles.description: Blast said operating costs now exceed the revenue its Ethereum layer-2 generates and asked users to withdraw their assets to mainnet before Oct. 26.

articles.title: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why
articles.description: Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to one analysis.
